DESTINATION: Embekka Devalaya
TYPE: Religious Site
LOCATION: Sri Lanka
COORDINATES: 7.2179, 80.5677
DESCRIPTION: Buddhist temple in Kandy District, Sri Lanka
SOURCE: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Embekka_Devalaya

Embekka Devalaya was built by the King Vikramabahu III of Gampola Era in Sri Lanka. The Devalaya is dedicated to Kataragama deviyo, a form of Kartikeya. A local deity called Devatha Bandara is also worshiped at this site. The shrine consists of three sections, the "Sanctum of Garagha", the "Digge" or "Dancing Hall" and the "Hevisi Mandapaya" or the "Drummers' Hall". The Drummers' Hall has drawn the attention of visitors to the site, due to the splendid wood carvings of its ornate pillars and its high pitched roof.
